review_scope: Bounded source/assertion review. Parent findings and gate-results supersede draft/run status. Neither whole-clause nor all-feature certification.

reviewer_record.feature: Image forms: XObject and inline image; mask variants and interpolation; all bit depths
reviewer_record.granularity: Rows distinct; umbrella rows aggregate not substitutes for clause obligations.
reviewer_record.audit_note: Bit depths, row-byte alignment, XObject/inline routes, and inline abbreviation/filter terminators are individually represented. §8.9.5.3 Interpolate is a separate row; verify assertions distinguish nearest vs interpolated patterns, not simply dictionary acceptance.

reviewer_record.feature: Image placement matrix and image parameters; coordinate order/orientation
reviewer_record.granularity: Both rows exist and are mapped to placement tests.
reviewer_record.audit_note: Image row-top orientation, matrix placement and rotations are directly test-addressed. No reason to infer sample correctness from transform tests.

reviewer_record.feature: Image dictionary required entries, filter/sample consistency, intent, ColorSpace/JPX precedence, /OC visibility, /Alternates, masks and transparency entries
reviewer_record.granularity: One Table 87 row fans across multiple ledger rows where consumer behavior is defined elsewhere; the .1 row lists the whole table but does not independently grant evidence to every entry.
reviewer_record.audit_note: Required width/height/space/depth and now base /Decode cardinality have focused errors; intent, optional content, alternates, explicit/color-key/soft masks are separately represented. Candidate missing base Decode element type validation is in findings/draft. Ordinary JPX SMaskInData 1/2 consumer rendering was missing a focused row-level test; draft ordinary_jpx_smaskindata.rs is now prepared. Producer constraints don't imply reader must reject contradictory malformed entries.

reviewer_record.feature: General Decode arrays, per-space default pairs, clamp and inversion
reviewer_record.granularity: Decode row owns generalized mapping; stencil inversion and color-key raw-domain comparison are specific consumer obligations in mask rows.
reviewer_record.audit_note: General map and defaults include direct pixel assertions. Current validator does not validate nonnumeric values in an otherwise correct-length base array; possible missing granularity is in findings. JPX absent-ColorSpace exception is in §7.4.9/8.9.5.1 row.

reviewer_record.feature: Image color-key mask raw sample tuple, inclusive ranges, codecs/depths, Mask/SMask precedence
reviewer_record.granularity: Distinct clause behavior is represented in both image mask and transparency precedence rows.
reviewer_record.audit_note: Tests assert raw-sample pre-Decode behavior and codec-specific domains, inclusive limits, indexed entries, /SMask winning over /Mask, plus current graphics-state interaction. Verify malformed array entries are reported as stated; don't treat warning about lossy filters as reader exemption.

reviewer_record.feature: Explicit stencil mask decode and mapping; image-mask forbidden keys under EC3 #215
reviewer_record.granularity: Subclause row plus general dictionary row.
reviewer_record.audit_note: Public pixels cover normal/inverted stencil, fill color/pattern, mask transform, dimensions and soft-mask interplay. EC3 ignore of forbidden /Mask and /ColorSpace and BPC error are separately tested. A forbidden producer entry alone is not mandatory reader rejection.

reviewer_record.feature: Soft-mask image precedence, sample-grid mapping, matte preblend inversion in correct color domain, /SMaskInData
reviewer_record.granularity: Table 143/144 image details owned by .5.2; ordering/priorities owned by .4.3; JPX packaging behavior also referenced from .5.1.
reviewer_record.audit_note: Matte in RGB, CMYK and Indexed domains and no-Matte different grid are asserted. Table 143 equality of dimensions applies only where Matte is present; otherwise grids are independent and both map unit square. Ordinary color JPX embedded alpha draft closes key public consumer gap. `/Matte` on an embedded-alpha image is not a valid combo because Table 144 belongs to the SMask dictionary.

reviewer_record.feature: Graphics-state soft-mask dictionary /G, subtype, BBox/Matrix, /BC, transfer, alpha and luminosity, knockout group behavior
reviewer_record.granularity: Separate derivation rows and dictionary row. 11.5.3 is departed only for CIE-based luminosity branch per owner ratification; other measured spaces/branches are implemented. Do not report the whole row as missing.
reviewer_record.audit_note: Matrix order, /None, alpha/color independence, luminosity, transfer function including outside BBox, backdrop, resources and simple /K true overlap are covered. `soft_mask_dictionary_audit.rs` is a direct pixel regression for knockout vs normal. Damaged group prefix is an explicitly chosen, reported recovery, not a guaranteed ISO subset.

reviewer_record.feature: Transparency shape/opacity source precedence, image opacity, alpha constants, image's own mask override vs graphics-state mask
reviewer_record.granularity: Distinct object alpha/shape vs constant vs graphics-state mask vs image dictionary mask semantics are represented in separate rows; image direct masks also appear §8.9.6.
reviewer_record.audit_note: Image mask and transparency consumers are tested. Keep behavior of invalid simultaneous /SMask and nonzero /SMaskInData separate: standard says producer shall not do so, but no automatic reader error follows.

reviewer_record.feature: Blend modes, blending color space and alpha equations; group and patterns in transparency
reviewer_record.granularity: Separate rows with tests and explicit backend behavior (GPU refusal is surfaced).
reviewer_record.audit_note: The ledger has granular test lists for named blend functions, group isolation/knockout/own spaces, patterns, nested conversion and backend unsupported cases. Scope is broad and was not exhaustively replayed here; no missing top-level row found.
